## Expanding Fleet Title & Registration Support


Managing vehicle titles and registrations across multiple states is one of the most complex administrative challenges facing fleet operators today. As fleets expand, so does the need to navigate varying state requirements, timelines, and processes. Verra Mobility continues to expand its Title & Registration capabilities to help customers simplify compliance, improve efficiency, and reduce administrative burden through a single trusted partner.


## New State Registration Capabilities Now Available


Verra Mobility has expanded its Title & Registration footprint to 18 states with the addition of:


- **Georgia:** Registration renewals now available


- **Indiana:** Registration renewals now available


- **New Jersey:** Full-service title and registration processing now available


These additions expand Verra Mobility's Title & Registration footprint to 18 states, enabling customers to manage more of their registration activity through a single provider while benefiting from standardized processes, technology-enabled workflows, and state-specific expertise.


Georgia, Indiana, and New Jersey represent important operating markets for fleets, rental companies, and commercial vehicle operators. Expanded support in these states allows customers to consolidate registration activities with a trusted partner, creating a more consistent and scalable operating model across their fleet portfolio.

## Simplifying Vehicle Registration Management Across States


As fleet operations expand across multiple jurisdictions, registration complexity increases. Verra Mobility's growing Title & Registration network helps organizations streamline compliance activities, reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and better manage state-specific requirements through technology-enabled solutions.


## Supporting the Future of Title & Registration


The expansion to 18 states represents another milestone in Verra Mobility's modernization strategy to transform title and registration management. Earlier this year, the company launched its AI-driven Title & Registration solution, helping accelerate vehicle activation, reduce manual processing, and streamline registration workflows. Combined with expanded state coverage, Verra Mobility continues to simplify the title and registration experience for customers nationwide.


**Read more:**[How Verra Mobility's AI-Driven Title & Registration Solution Can Cut Fleet Vehicle Activation Time by Up to 80%](https://www.verramobility.com/verra-mobility-launches-ai-driven-title-registration-solution-cutting-fleet-vehicle-activation-time-up-to-80/)


## Learn More About Verra Mobility Title & Registration Solutions


Whether you're managing a fleet, rental operation, or commercial vehicle program, Verra Mobility helps simplify title and registration management through a combination of AI-driven technology, automation, and deep state-specific expertise. Customers benefit from fewer manual processes, improved consistency, and a scalable approach to managing vehicle compliance across multiple jurisdictions.


As Verra Mobility continues expanding its national footprint, customers gain broader coverage, simplified operations, and a trusted partner dedicated to reducing the complexity of vehicle title and registration management.
